***********************************************
* VGM music package                           *
* https://www.smspower.org/Music              *
***********************************************

Game name:           Sonic The Hedgehog
System:              Sega Master System
Complete music dump: Yes
FM:                  No

Music author:
  Yuzo Koshiro (Arragement and original music)
  Masato Nakamura (Mega Drive compositions)
Publisher:           Sega
Package created by:  Valley Bell
Package version:     2.11


Files, in approximate game order:

Name                                Length:
                                    Total  Loop
Title Screen                        0:08   -
Act Start                           0:02   -
Green Hill Zone                     0:53   0:38
Invincibility                       0:10   0:10
Act Complete                        0:05   -
Bonus Zone                          1:00   1:00
Chaos Emerald                       0:04   -
Dr. Robotnik                        0:12   0:12
Bridge Zone                         0:26   0:26
Jungle Zone                         0:29   0:29
Labyrinth Zone                      0:29   0:29
Scrap Brain Zone                    0:52   0:51
Sky Base Zone                       0:16   0:16
Ending                              1:33   -
Death                               0:04   -
Marble Zone (Unused)                0:33   0:32

Total Length                        7:14   5:01


Notes:

All files were logged with Kega Fusion 3.63 and
with the use of Maxim's Start-Button-Hack.

Masato Nakamura made the music for the Mega
Drive version; Yuzo Koshiro ported some of it
and composed the rest.


Package history:
2001/10/26 Version 1.00 (fx^, Maxim, and
  Agustín): The oldest version I (Valley Bell) 
  could find.
2005/01/23 Version 1.10 (Grass-eatin'me): Songs
  relogged?
2005/07/12 Version 1.11 (Grass-eatin'me):
  Composer Masato Nakamura added.
2010/10/20 Version 2.00 (Valley Bell): All
  tracks relogged, too many had looping/trimming
  errors. Song order changed.
2015/05/29 Version 2.10 (Valley Bell): Added
  unused Marble Zone track, found by Kroc. VGM
  file created by Valley Bell.
2026/09.27 Version 2.11 (Maxim): Repacked and
  reordered by game order, renamed some tracks
  slightly, removed kana track titles, fixed
  some missing Nakamura credits.
